presets.name: Kessari
presets.label: Kessari — hot, high-pressure worlds (Hail Mary–style)
presets.description: A people at home in sulfur-band climates and around Jupiter-like gas giants. They overlap humans only where a star has both a rocky Goldilocks world and a giant.

presets.name: Methan
presets.label: Methan — gas-giant station dwellers
presets.description: Methane-breathers. They live in stations and structures inside or around Jupiter-like gas giants, not on rocky ground.

presets.name: Crystomorphs
presets.label: Crystomorphs — living crystal, high on the sky
presets.description: Beings that look like living crystal. They prefer stars far from the celestial equator (high north or south on the sky), away from the thickest human traffic.

presets.name: Echryon & Echtol
presets.label: Echryon & Echtol — one sky quarter (northeast)
presets.description: Defined by starting location: the first quarter of the sky (east of Sol’s zero line and north). A regional people, not a habitat type.

presets.name: Aboreals
presets.label: Aboreals — sky quarter (southeast)
presets.description: Defined by starting location: the next sky quarter, south of the celestial equator.

presets.name: Bazzar
presets.label: Bazzar — sky quarter (southwest)
presets.description: Defined by starting location: the third sky quarter, south of the equator.

presets.name: Schettel
presets.label: Schettel — rim / poor worlds
presets.description: Edge-of-the-sphere people. They take leftover, low-score systems or stars far from Sol — the rim of human-explored space.

presets.name: Turquenish Empire
presets.label: Turquenish Empire — Sol’s human wedge
presets.description: The human polity that starts at Sol and claims the first third of the sky around it.

presets.name: Mardat Coalition
presets.label: Mardat Coalition — next human wedge
presets.description: Human nation on the next slice of sky after the Empire.

presets.name: Industrial Hegemony
presets.label: Industrial Hegemony — industrial sky slice
presets.description: A smaller human bloc on a later sky wedge.

presets.name: League of The Faithful
presets.label: League of The Faithful — far-sky human slice
presets.description: A tiny human league on the last sky wedge.

presets.name: Other Human
presets.label: Other Human — leftovers
presets.description: Independent or mixed human holdings. Takes whatever good systems remain after the other cultures pick.

presets.name: Wedge from a home star
presets.label: Direction from a home star — 15° sky slices
presets.description: Starts at a chosen star (not the edge of the map) and claims systems in one 15° slice around it. Widen the slice if you want a bigger nation.

presets.name: Neighbors of a home star
presets.label: Near a home star — a pocket around one system
presets.description: Claims stars close to a chosen host. Use this for a culture that starts at Tau Ceti (or Sol) and holds the local pocket, not a far rim.

presets.name: Rim from a home star
presets.label: Far from a home star — rim of that star’s neighborhood
presets.description: The old Schettel idea, but measured from any host you pick: far from that starting star, on the edge of its explored sphere.

presets.name: New people
presets.label: Custom species — you name them
presets.description: A new non-human culture. Rename them, then pick a placement rule (gas giants, crystal skies, a sky quarter, or the rim).

presets.name: New human nation
presets.label: Custom human nation — you name them
presets.description: A new human polity. Rename them, then pick which slice of leftover stars they prefer.
